title: SubscriptionRejectedFrame
description: Server subscription rejection frame sent when one or more requested topic subscriptions cannot be established (e.g. unknown topic, expired or invalid resume cursor, or unauthorized access).

topics.description: List of topic names whose subscription was rejected.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the subscription was rejected.

code.description: Optional machine-readable rejection code (e.g. unknown_topic, invalid_cursor, unauthorized).
